facts.text: All incoming first-year undergraduate students, excluding transfer students, must complete a one-credit First-Year Odyssey seminar.

sources.title: Students | Landing - First Year Odyssey - University of Georgia
sources.quote: These one credit-hour seminars are taught by tenured, tenure-track, clinical, and retired faculty and are graded on an A-F scale. All incoming first-year students, excluding transfer students, must take an FYO seminar during their first year.
